name: Print Editorial Page
description: A full page built like an editorial spread: a dominant image and headline across the top, a disciplined information block beneath, and the brand mark and any legal or contact line in the footer. Carries more than a feed asset without losing a single entry point.
spacing: A firm horizontal division between the image-and-headline band and the information block, with consistent column gutters through the lower half and the footer set off by clear space.
responsive_behavior: Between A4 portrait and landscape the image band changes height and the information block reflows across the six columns. The footer stays a single row.
